scope: outside timing; original source tokens and projected canonical inputs

definitions.decimal_precision: lexical Decimal exponent including trailing zeros; floating-point export artifacts are retained; not source sensor resolution
definitions.statistics: finite values only; population std (ddof=0); NumPy linear quantiles; numeric equality merges signed zero only for unique/equal counts
definitions.trend_and_residual: OLS against row index; residual RMSE is a descriptive deviation from a line, not an identified measurement-noise estimate
definitions.lag1: Pearson correlation of adjacent finite pairs; null when absent/constant; no gaps are joined
definitions.identity: raw_object_id includes task schema, component descriptors/layout and bytes; component hashes follow declared C/F logical order

license.scope: MPI official data download page declares CC-BY-4.0. All 21 parsed numeric columns and timestamps match the two official 2020 roof archives. An additional license for the researcher-preprocessed CSV packaging was not found.
license.publication_policy: Do not bundle the preprocessed CSV; provide exact upstream/Drive acquisition routes, hashes, and MPI attribution. Code repository licenses are not used as data licenses.

upstream.version_policy: Drive file id is mutable; exact CSV SHA-256 defines the frozen data version, not the code commit
upstream.byte_identity_to_remote: verified exact bytes and SHA-256 from the file linked by the author README
upstream.citation: Wu et al., Autoformer, NeurIPS 2021, https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.13008

primary_source_comparison.comparison: Concatenate mpi_roof_2020a.csv then mpi_roof_2020b.csv; parse Latin-1 source CSV; dates dd.mm.yyyy to yyyy-mm-dd; float() then little-endian f64 for all 21 values; compare same row order

acquisition.manual_instructions: If the direct download is blocked/quota-limited, open https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Xz84ci5YKWL6O2I-58ZsVe42lYIfqui1, download weather.csv, place the unchanged CSV in --directory, and run verify. Never accept a browser HTML/quota page as CSV.
